### This portfolio

This site is built with Vite, React and Tailwind CSS. Its UI is a tribute to Avi Vashishta's Portfolio2021 layout. It ships three things most portfolios do not: a retrieval-augmented terminal that answers questions about Yash from a local knowledge base, an llms.txt endpoint so language-model crawlers can read Yash's profile as structured text, and optional webcam hand-tracking that lets you scroll and click with gestures.
